description: This Java class 'DefaultPersistenceConfig' provides the default implementation for health check persistence configuration, including properties like enabled status, timeout duration, and metrics reporter configuration. It includes methods for instantiation from a config object, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing PersistenceConfig, representing persistence configuration with properties enabled, timeout, and metricsReporterConfig.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultPersistenceConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for persistence.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
